description: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers of a model's attention and feed-forward components, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 20 on a linear scale and the y-axis representing the Max Activation Value ranging from 0 to 1600 on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: the blue dashed line labeled "attn_output" starts near zero, rises sharply to approximately 200 at layer 5, and then remains low until layer 20 where it ends near 200; the orange dotted line labeled "attn_residual" begins near zero, spikes to approximately 1450 at layer 5, plateaus near 1600 until layer 15, and then declines to around 600 by layer 20; the green dashed line labeled "ffn_output" starts near zero, rises steeply to approximately 1200 at layer 5, then sharply declines to near zero by layer 10, and subsequently rises again to approximately 1200 at layer 15 before dropping back to near zero by layer 20; and the red solid line labeled "ffn_residual" begins near zero, rises to approximately 1400 at layer 5, plateaus near 1600 until layer 15, and then declines to approximately 600 by layer 20.
